name: 3-Jikan to 1-Pun no White Day
source:
A sound novel about repaying someone important  
March 14th.  
The long-awaited White Day.  
On the way to give chocolate back to the person I have feelings for, 'I' am approached by a suspicious fortune teller.  
And the prophecy I receive is something I never expected.  

'You will die in three hours.'  

――Can you change your fate?

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8803]Freem![/url]]
translation:
一部关于向重要之人回礼的有声视觉小说。
3月14日。
期盼已久的白色情人节。
在前往向心仪之人回赠巧克力的路上，“我”被一名形迹可疑的占卜师拦住了去路。
而我听到的预言，完全超乎了想象。

“你将在三小时后死去。”

——你能否改变自己的命运？

[摘自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/8803]Freem![/url]]
